Ebola Disease Outbreak — SIR Modelling Report

Integrating Statistical Modelling into Understanding and Predicting Ebola Outbreak 2026

RDHUB Analytics

2026-10-17

Overview

Automated daily pipeline for the Ebola Disease Outbreak Analysis Portal. This report shares its dataset, parameter estimates and performance metrics with the interactive portal at the repository root.

  • Population at risk: 20,000,000 persons
  • Data stream: confirmed cases only
  • Projection horizon: 14 days
  • Train / test split: 80 % / 20 %
